Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa

Class FactorTimeline

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.mfa.FactorTimeline
@Component public class FactorTimeline extends Object
Reads, from the FactorGrantedAuthority instances of an authentication, the factors that prove something about it and when they were presented. It is the single place the claims (MfaClaimsContributor) and the step-up checks (StepUpAuthorizationRequestConverter) take amr, acr and auth_time from, so both always agree:
  • only the factors of the AuthenticationFactorRegistry that MfaPolicy.isReported(com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.mfa.AuthenticationFactor) accepts count: a remembered (trusted) device does not;
  • the authentication is multi-factor when MfaPolicy.isMultiFactor(java.util.Set<com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.mfa.AuthenticationFactor>) says so: at least two distinct factors count, or one counted factor proves a multi-factor authentication alone;
  • auth_time is when the primary factor was presented (the earliest one when there are several), so a second factor added later never makes the sign-in look newer; without a primary factor it is the earliest counted factor.
